collection.description: A Magic practitioner claims to have learned a spell that can briefly strengthen a failing heartbeat.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A Magic practitioner claims to have learned a spell that can briefly strengthen a failing heartbeat.

choices.label: Offer the spell with the patient's permission.
Use ordinary treatment and keep the practitioner nearby.
Record the spell's effects before relying on it.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The pulse steadies for an hour, leaving its cause uncertain.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: The spell seems to fail, and the patient dies despite further care.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The patient recovers slowly while the practitioner offers companionship.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: The patient asks for the spell later, after hearing the risks.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The practitioner discovers the spell requires exhausting concentration and may not be dependable.
